description: Land Acquisition - Thirunagar, Jaffna D/S Division, Jaffna District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically describes the government's intention to acquire a particular plot of land (including its location, lot number, and extent) for the public purpose of constructing a sewerage pumping station. The content is entirely focused on land acquisition procedures, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
